en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqu, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Abu Abdullah, a man from our companions, raising it, said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
And in another Hadeeth, he (the narrator) said, ‘
Seeking the knowledge is mandatory upon every Muslim. Indeed! And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves the seeker of the knowledge’’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people has narrated has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi from Ya’qub ibn Yazid from abu ‘Abdallah, a man of our people narrated in a marfu‘ manner from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) from the Holy Prophet (s.a) who has said the following. “
Imam abu ‘Abdallah has narrated from the holy Prophet
who said, “Seeking knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim. Let it be known that Allah loves those who seek knowledge.”
